## What you propose

- [ ] A new agent, or a change to an agent
- [ ] A playbook for a product type

<!-- One or two sentences. -->

## Phase and step

<!-- Discover, Validate, Build, Commercial setup, Launch, or Operate and learn. Which step does it cover? -->

## Input and output

<!-- What the agent reads (brief, earlier outputs, fetched sources) and what it returns, as fields. -->

## Gate

<!-- How the step ends: founder approval, an evidence target set in advance, or passing tests. When should it recommend stopping? -->

## Evidence

<!-- Which claims will it make, and how are they sourced? Anything without a fetched source is labelled ASSUMPTION. -->

## Safety checklist

- [ ] No payment code, not even sandbox
- [ ] No invented reviews, testimonials, sign-up counts or countdowns
- [ ] Nothing published, sent, spent or signed without founder approval of the exact content
- [ ] Mocked or unbuilt parts labelled `MOCKED` or `STUBBED`
- [ ] Not for an excluded product type (physical goods; financial, investment or crypto; health or legal advice)
